title: Four more ways to build and play
summary:
Community-made tools took the lead, while small changes made projects easier to find and OpenAI-compatible requests more private.

The directory gained a real-time language-model comparison tool and two image generators: Zelos AI, which enhances prompts, and image1gen, a web interface for the API. The Social Bots list also gained One Word, a Telegram word game that turns players’ words into images.

The Projects page got a shorter submission prompt. Shared links now use a banner, with updated preview metadata and structured data to help the site appear more clearly in search results.

Default-private handling was merged for OpenAI-compatible requests, without changing the behavior of other routes.
